# RankFootprint

> RankFootprint is a Google Maps grid rank tracker for local businesses and local SEO agencies. It checks where a business appears in Google Maps results from a grid of evenly spaced points across its service area (3×3 = 9 points, 5×5 = 25, 7×7 = 49, 9×9 = 81) and shows the rank at each point as a map of tiles. Operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC, a Florida limited liability company. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

## Key facts
- What it measures: a business's Google Maps (local pack) position for one search phrase at each grid point, plus average rank, coverage (share of points where the business appears) and top-3 share.
- Why a grid: Google Maps results depend heavily on where the searcher is, so a single rank check from the office usually shows the best case.
- Data source: licensed third-party search data providers. RankFootprint does not run its own scrapers.
- Free offer: a free 3×3 scan (9 points).
- Pricing (USD, monthly, cancel any time): Starter $19 (1 business, 3 phrases, 3×3 grid, monthly scans); Growth $29 (2 businesses, 6 phrases, next-step tips); Agency $49 (5 businesses, 10 phrases, plus one 5×5 grid a month, branded client reports). Early access currently has a limited number of founding spots; scans are delivered within 24 hours.
- Publisher: Joshua Israel Ventures LLC (Florida). Contact via https://rankfootprint.com/contact/
